title: Fiesta de Luz Christmas Boat Parade Returns to Lake Casa Blanca on Dec. 12
excerpt: Lake Casa Blanca is bringing back its Fiesta de Luz Christmas boat parade on Saturday, Dec. 12, from 7 to 8:30 p.m. — the event's return after it stopped during the COVID-19 pandemic.
content:
Lake Casa Blanca is bringing back its Fiesta de Luz Christmas boat parade on Saturday, December 12, from 7 to 8:30 p.m. at the park's boat ramp, inviting boaters to decorate their boats and celebrate the holiday season together on the water.

The parade is returning after it stopped during the COVID-19 pandemic. Visitors have been asking for it for a few years, and the park finally got the opportunity to bring it back, said Querubín Guerra, superintendent of Lake Casa Blanca International State Park.

Recent rain raised the lake's water level, making the return possible. Before the rain, the lake was about 11 to 12 feet deep at its deepest point; it is now a little over 18 feet deep, and all three of the park's concrete boat ramps are usable.

Up to 20 boats can take part in the parade. There is no fee to enter, and there is no judging or prizes. Boaters need to arrive early to decorate their boats and pass a safety inspection.

Park entry costs $4 for visitors ages 13 and older. The park held a test run on the Fourth of July, when four boats participated.

Boaters should stay alert on the water: because the recent water came in through the creeks, grass clumps and other debris are floating in and around the lake, and plastic bags and jugs can clog a motor or catch a propeller.

Source: Lake Casa Blanca International State Park, November 2026.
